summary: RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms such as MinIO and Ceph.
usecases: Storing large-scale data in a distributed, scalable manner
Providing alternative S3-compatible storage solutions for cloud-native applications
Enabling hybrid storage architectures combining different object storage backends
ideas: Integrate with Kubernetes for dynamic scaling of object storage instances
Combine with serverless functions for on-demand data processing workflows
Implement cross-platform compatibility with multiple cloud providers
